en: A vintage black-and-white postcard showing a colonial-style stone church with arched portico, heavy buttresses and two ornate bell towers. To the left stands a separate, simpler bell tower with two large arched openings. There is a stone cross on a pedestal in front of the church and a few people in early 20th‑century clothing walking or standing nearby. In the upper left corner, handwritten text identifies the building as the Church of Santo Domingo in Ayacucho.
